title: A tree-based kernel for densities and its applications in clustering DNase-seq profiles
authors: Yuliang Xu; Kaixuan Luo; Li Ma
one_liner_zh: 该文提出一种基于树的密度核用于DNase-seq染色质可及性谱聚类，以检测转录因子结合足迹，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点检测但方法为贝叶斯统计聚类，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作相关但方法不匹配。
abstract: Modeling multiple sampling densities within a hierarchical framework enables borrowing of information across samples. These density random effects can act as kernels in latent variable models to represent exchangeable subgroups or clusters. A key feature of these kernels is the (functional) covariance they induce, which determines how densities are grouped in mixture models. Our motivating problem is clustering chromatin accessibility profiles from high-throughput DNase-seq experiments to detect transcription factor (TF) binding. TF binding typically produces footprint profiles with spatial patterns, creating long-range dependency across genomic locations. Existing nonparametric hierarchical models impose restrictive covariance assumptions and cannot accommodate such dependencies, often leading to biologically uninformative clusters. We propose a nonparametric density kernel flexible enough to capture diverse covariance structures and adaptive to various spatial patterns of TF footprints. The kernel specifies dyadic tree splitting probabilities via a multivariate logit-normal model with a sparse precision matrix. Bayesian inference for latent variable models using this kernel is implemented through Gibbs sampling with Polya-Gamma augmentation. Extensive simulations show that our kernel substantially improves clustering accuracy. We apply the proposed mixture model to DNase-seq data from the ENCODE project, which results in biologically meaningful clusters corresponding to binding events of two common TFs.
abstract_zh: 在分层框架内对多个采样密度进行建模，能够实现跨样本的信息借用。这些密度随机效应可作为潜变量模型中的核，用以表示可交换的子组或聚类。这些核的一个关键特征是其诱导的（函数性）协方差，该协方差决定了混合模型中密度的分组方式。我们面临的动机问题是，对来自高通量DNase-seq实验的染色质可及性图谱进行聚类，以检测转录因子（TF）结合。TF结合通常产生具有空间模式的足迹图谱，从而在基因组位置间形成长程依赖性。现有的非参数分层模型施加了限制性的协方差假设，无法适应此类依赖性，往往导致生物学上无信息的聚类。我们提出一种非参数密度核，其足够灵活以捕捉多样的协方差结构，并适应TF足迹的各种空间模式。该核通过具有稀疏精度矩阵的多元logit-normal模型指定二叉树的划分概率。使用此核的潜变量模型的贝叶斯推断通过Polya-Gamma增广的吉布斯采样实现。广泛模拟表明，我们的核显著提高了聚类准确性。我们将所提出的混合模型应用于ENCODE项目的DNase-seq数据，结果产生了与两种常见TF结合事件相对应的生物学上有意义的聚类。
